questions.question: Sudden decrease of birth rate would cause_________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Increase in per capita income**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• It is observed that people who earn less, tend to produce more children due to the notion that more children will contribute to the economy of the house.
 
• Moreover, they are not so educated and do not use contraceptives often. So, if a sudden decrease in the birth rate is found, it may lead to an increase in per capita income.

questions.question: In the last one decade, which one among the following sectors has attracted the highest foreign direct investment inflows into India?
questions.solution:

__
 
• The service sector has contributed the highest foreign direct investment inflows into India.
 
• **Since telecommunications is part of the Service sector, so this is the correct answer.**

__
 
• According to a research report published on 28 December 2022 by the India Ratings & Research (Ind-Ra), the Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in India was maximum in the service sectors.

questions.question: What is called the minimum distance from the Sun in a planet in its orbit?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Perihelion__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Perihelion is the point in the orbit of the planet that is closest to the sun and Aphelion is the point in the orbit of the planet that is farthest from the sun.
 
• Perigee is that point in the orbit of the moon that is closest to the Earth and apogee is that point in the orbit of the moon that is farthest from the Earth. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Aphelion**

__
 
• the Earth is farthest away from the Sun, at the Aphelion point, 2 weeks after the June Solstice, when the Northern Hemisphere is enjoying warm summer months.

​**Apogee**

 
• The point of the orbit where the satellite is farthest from the Earth is called apogee.__
 
• The maximum distance of the moon from the earth (4,06,000 km) is called apogee. 

**Perigee**

 
• The minimum distance of the moon from the earth (3,64,000) is called perigee.

questions.question: Which of the following statement(s) is/are CORRECT?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Oxides of non-metals are acidic.**__

__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• Most of the oxides of non-metals are acidic and oxides of metals are basic.
 
• But, not all oxides of non-metals are acidic e.g. Carbon monoxide is not acidic and the same is the case with bases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Oxides** are compounds formed by the reaction of metals, and non-metals with oxygen.
 
• 
 
The types of oxides are:

 
 
• Basic oxide: It is a complex chemical substance oxide, which forms a salt with a chemical reaction with acids or acidic oxides and does not react with bases or basic oxides.
 
• E.g. Copper oxide (Cu2O), Magnesium oxide (MgO)
 
• Acidic oxide: It is a complex chemical substance oxide, which forms a salt with chemical reactions with bases or basic oxides and does not react with acidic oxides.
 
• E.g. Carbon dioxide (CO2), Silicon dioxide (SiO2)
 
• Amphoteric oxide: It is a complex chemical substance, also oxide, which forms a salt with chemical reactions with acids (or acid oxides) and with bases (or basic oxides).

questions.question: In India, which of the following body is Constitutional in nature?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Finance Commission.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Finance Commission **is a constitutional body mentioned in **Article 280** and is responsible to define financial relations between the central Govt. and the state Govt. Recently, in **2017, the 15th Finance Commission was constituted, chaired by N.K. Singh.**
 
• NITI Aayog is neither statuary nor Constitutional in nature. It is the Govt. think tank. National Human Rights Commission and Central Vigilance Commission are the statuary bodies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• National Human Rights Commission

 
 
• In 1993, the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) was founded.
 
• In accordance with the guidelines of the 1993 Protection of Human Rights Act, it is a statutory autonomous authority.
 
• It was amended in 2006.
 
• The National Human Rights Commission is currently presided over by Shri Justice Arun Kumar Mishra.
 
• He assumed on June 2, 2021.
 
• The NHRC examines a person's rights to life, dignity, liberty, and equality as those terms are specified in Section 2(1) of the PHR Act.​
 
 
 
• NITI Aayog:
 
 
• NITI Aayog or National Institution for Transforming India Aayog is the replacement for the Planning Commission of India.
 
• National Institution for Transforming India (NITI) Aayog was created by Prime Minister, Narendra Modi on 15 August 2014.
 
• Prime Minister is the Chairperson.
 
 

 
• Central Vigilance Commission

 
 
• The **Central Vigilance Commission** was set up by the Government in** February 1964** on the recommendations of the Committee on Prevention of Corruption, headed by Shri** K. Santhanam,** to advise and guide Central Government agencies in the field of vigilance.
 
• CVC is conceived to be the apex vigilance institution, free of control from any executive authority, monitoring all vigilance activity under the Central Government and advising various authorities in Central Government organizations in planning, executing, reviewing and reforming their vigilant work.
 
• Consequent upon promulgation of an Ordinance by the President, the Central Vigilance Commission has been made a multi-member Commission with "statutory status" with effect from 25th August 1998.

questions.question: Organisms use bio-catalyst to break down complex substances into simpler substances. These bio catalysts are called ________.

__

• Enzymes are proteins made from amino acids.
 
• It is made up of hundreds and thousands of amino acids stringed together in a very specific and unique order.
 
• Any chemical reaction inside a cell or any work that goes on inside a cell is the handiwork of enzymes inside the cell.
 
• The word enzyme was coined in 1878 by German Scientist Wilhelm Kuhne.
 
• Enzymes act as biological catalysts (biocatalysts).
 
• Catalysts accelerate chemical reactions.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Hormones are non-nutrient chemicals.

 
 
• A physical change occurs in the body through certain chemical substances called hormones.
 
• The hormone is secreted by the endocrine glands into the blood.

questions.question: In July 2017, RBI capped how much Customer liability if they report unauthorized transactions within seven working days?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs 25,000.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• By capping **client liability at Rs 25,000** if they report **unauthorized transactions** within **seven working days**, RBI has taken a significant step toward protecting customers from **significant financial losses** as a result of fraud.
 
• If clients tell the bank within** three working days** of the transaction, they **cannot be held** at all accountable.
 
• When a** third party commits a breach**, these regulations will apply because the problem isn't with the bank or the consumer, but rather somewhere **else in the system.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Limited liability of a customer:**
 
• In the following circumstances, a customer is responsible for any **loss brought on by unauthorized transactions:**
 
 
• Customers will be responsible for the whole loss up until they notify the bank of the unauthorized transaction in circumstances where the loss was caused by their negligence, such as when they **disclosed their payment credentials.**
 
• The bank will be responsible for **covering any losses** that arise after the** unlawful transaction** has been reported.

questions.question: On 10 April 2017, Lok Sabha passed the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2016. The Bill seeks to amend _________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.**__

__
 
• In order to address issues **including third-party insurance, regulating cab aggregators, and road safety**, the Bill changes the** Motor Vehicles Act of 1988.**
 
• The** third-party insurer** has unlimited liability under the Act for motor vehicle incidents.
 
• The Bill **limits third-party insurance's** maximum responsibility in the event of a motor vehicle accident to **Rs. 10 lakh in cases of death and Rs. 5 lakh **in cases of serious injury.
 
• The bill calls for the establishment of a **Motor Vehicle Accident Fund,** which would mandate insurance coverage for specific sorts of incidents for all Indian road users.
 
• The Bill establishes the** definition of cab aggregator**s, whose rules will be set by the** national government.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Mr. Nitin Gadkari, t**he Minister of Road Transport and Highways,** introduced the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2019 in the** Lok Sabha.**
 
• The Motor Vehicles Act, **1988 is being amende**d by the bill to include provisions for** traffic safety.**
 
• The Act establishes requirements for **motor vehicles, the issuance of licenses and permits relating to motor vehicles, and sanctions** for violations of these laws.

questions.question: What is the effective resistance (in Ω) of two resistors 20 Ω and 30 Ω connected in parallel?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__12.__**

**__Calculation:__**

If two resistances, R₁ and R₂ are connected in parallel, then effective resistance, R is:

1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂,

Here, R₁=20 Ω and R₂ =30 Ω

So, 1/R = 1/20 + 1/30, or, R = 600/50 = 12 Ω.
